availableMessage: A newer Finledge release is available on GitHub. Review what changed and install it from the official release page.
requiredMessage: This Finledge version is no longer supported. Please install the latest release from GitHub to continue receiving important fixes.
releaseNotes: Added SIP investment and redemption tracking.
Added bar charts to individual module dashboards for quicker insights.
Introduced a new update policy system with required/optional update indicators and release notes support.
Enhanced the dashboard with SIP summaries and a combined Grand Total for IPO and SIP.
